Console logs captured repeated 401s around refresh/assistant endpoints during failed automation attempts; this likely contributed to unstable post-login state.

rca of the issue: Observed behavior indicates environment/session instability during auth in preview automation rather than a confirmed diagnosis-print logic regression.
